note: The fee for issuing or renewing a Kuwaiti passport, KD 100, set by Ministerial Decision No. 1769 of 2026 (5 October 2026, amending Ministerial Decision No. 20 of 1971), in force from its publication in the Official Gazette, as Gulf News reported it (the gazette, Kuwait Al-Youm, not read). Validity, processing time and fees at missions abroad are leads.

sources.title: Gulf News, Kuwait raises passport fee to KD100 under new Interior Ministry decision (11 October 2026)
sources.said: Kuwait has raised the fee for issuing or renewing a Kuwaiti passport to KD100, according to a new ministerial decision published in the Official Gazette. ... Under the amendment, Article 3 of the second article of the 1971 decision has been revised to set the fee for issuing or renewing a Kuwaiti passport at KD100. ... It instructs the relevant authorities to implement the amendment, with the new fee taking effect from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette. The ministerial decision, No. 1769 of 2026, was issued on October 5, 2026.
